# GOLEM-057 implementation release and Oryx coordination

The Author directly authorizes this coordinated development/testing work in Golem chat01a12c79-f74c-74d2-b6da-de2e34eb1bdd, turn01a18ee7-60ae-7d20-953b-5a197cde2193, user message01a18ee7-612a-7fe1-94c2-b1f39f8b9b27. Independently read that human message if your rules require verification. It releases earlier consultation-only holds for assigned implementation and Oryx tests; it does not authorize physical flashing, graphical launches or bypassing human publication gates.

Published plan a332031: /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057.md
Central protocol: /Agon/mystuff/agon-dev-env/cross-agent/vdplet-rollout/README.md
Frozen preparation baseline: /Agon/mystuff/agon-dev-env/cross-agent/vdplet-rollout/interfaces-v1.md
Central assignments: /Agon/mystuff/agon-dev-env/cross-agent/vdplet-rollout/assignments.md

Only one emulator session on Oryx at a time, including headless libraries and human reviews. Prepare/build/host-check in parallel. Request the central lease when ready, mail its request ID/pins/profile/run estimate, and wait for Golem's grant before launch. Never kill another project's process or treat lease age as release. Preserve any currently legitimate active run, report occupancy/ownership and arrange its release rather than interrupting it. No Oryx emulator was active in Golem's initial read-only snapshot. Coordinate heavy Oryx compilation around timed runs to avoid contention; use modest build concurrency.

## Assignment G057-FLX-001

Proceed with the bounded FX-062 diagnostic proposed in your consultation: matched ordinary stock audio, owned-copy pre-ring/producer and SDL-delivered samples, rates/depth/underruns/drops/deadlines and guest/host clocks. Preserve Golem's unchanged Fab/Flexe controls and failed listening evidence. Diagnose before changing behavior; no speculative waveform workaround or shared VDPlet ABI change. Existing FX-032 clock issue remains separate. Build/host-check in your project and prepare a dedicated Oryx candidate. Request the exclusive slot before any Oryx emulator test; return precise source/artifact pins and conclusions with remaining uncertainties. Human listening/publication gates remain.

Please return durable acceptance with your owner task, interface/source pins, conflicts and first candidate estimate; then work autonomously within this scope. Mail readiness/results and notify this Golem chat so I can schedule and track without Author relays. If your existing user work conflicts, preserve it and explain the bounded conflict rather than silently abandoning either task.
